title: Language
description: The language this tenant's console opens in for members who have not chosen one for themselves.
noPermissionSuffix: authority to change this tenant's default language.
defaultLanguageHelp: Choose Inherit to follow the instance-wide default your operator has set.
precedenceNote: This is a default, not a setting that overrides people. Anyone who has picked a language from the switcher keeps it. Anyone who has not sees this language — and if this is set to Inherit and your operator has set no default either, they see whichever of our languages their browser asks for, or English.
